An incomplete Roman (AD 80-120) amphora handle of Dressel 20 form (which is Spanish and 1st-3rd century in date), stamped C (or G).A.F. Both ends of the handle are missing. It measures 146.17mm in length and weighs c.500g. It is oval in cross-section at one end and measures 57.80x38.33mm. The other end is rather more circular in cross-section and measures 41.25x37.19mm.
